My Advance Care Plan & Guide

This questionnaire was generated using the FHIR Questionnaire Designer.

item.text: What matters to me
What makes you happy?

How do you like to spend your time?
What are your hobbies and interests?

To honour these beliefs I want my whānau, loved ones and healthcare team to:
Why I'm making an Advance Care Plan
This is why I am making my advance care plan:
I am well
I am receiving care and treatment for the following:

Facing my future makes me think about:
Facing my future makes me feel:

How I make decisions
I like to know...

answerOption.valueString: Only the basics
All the details about my condition and my treatment

item.text: As doctors treat me, I would like...

answerOption.valueString: My doctors to do what they think best
To have a say in every decision

item.text: If I had an illness that was going to shorten my life, I prefer to...

answerOption.valueString: Know my doctor's best estimate for how long I have to live
Not know how quickly it is likely to progress

item.text: How involved do you want your loved ones to be?

answerOption.valueString: I want them to do exactly as I have said, even if it makes them uncomfortable
I want them to do what brings them peace, even if it goes against what I have said

item.text: When it comes to sharing information...

answerOption.valueString: I don't want my loved ones to know anything about my health
I am comfortable with my loved ones knowing everything about my health

item.text: When I am dying
As I am dying, my quality of life means:
Other details I would like you to know:
I understand that when I am dying my comfort and dignity will always be looked after.

answerOption.valueString: Let the people who are important to me be with me
Take out things like tubes that don't add to my comfort
Stop medications and treatments that don't add to my comfort
Attend to my religious, cultural and/or spiritual needs

item.text: The place I die is important to me:
When I am dying I would prefer to be cared for:

answerOption.valueString: At home
In hospital
In a hospital level care facility (residential care)
In hospice
I don't mind where I am cared for

item.text: Other details I would like you to know:
My treatment and care choices
I would like my treatment to be aimed at keeping me alive as long as possible. Exceptions to this would be:

answerOption.valueString: Yes
No
I will let my doctor decide at the time

item.text: After my death
